notes.title: Teeny little fixes
notes.content:
Hey there! Here are a couple of fixes to make the game nicer:

[list]
[*] Extended some waiting times when comic clouds are created, this should help those few people that had the game get stuck during conversations.
[*] Fixed a few lines of translation after translators played some more and wanted to make creative changes.
[/list]

I hope you had lovely holidays :)

notes.title: Fixing ourselves up a bit :)
notes.content:
- Chinese and German translation updates - translators wanted to make the text fit the game even better :)
- Added Russian translators to credits
- A few seconds here or there to reduce the number of sudden scene changes
- Made some annoying sounds quieter
- Bridge handle in Big City now shakes invitingly from time to time so players have an easier time finding it
- Slightly louder ending music, also possibly fixed the thing that made it sometimes not play
- Fixed (I hope) music in lava river sometimes not playing 
- Reduced time how long to hold an object over the refablicator becaus everyone kept giving up too soon
- Lobworm and her puddle now make more sense

notes.title: minor fixes
notes.content:
- added a warning in the main menu when you restart the game
- a few minor tweaks and hints

notes.title: Cave Hikers start the expedition on 6th of December!
Let's Hike Again
notes.content:
Do you like streams? Wrong question. Have you thought about trying Cave Hikers demo but never mustered the strength to click install or play? Well, the wait is over! Now there is a developer, and his dog, here to do it for you while answering all your probing question, such as "What is the dog's name?" and many other dog-related questions, but also about the game itself!

What will the stream be like? Will there be a dedicated dog cam? Who will get the HD camera? Developer or dog? Come to the stream and all your questions may or may not be answered!

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/44899323/067284318487cd467e80241846396d68f52750b9.png[/img]

notes.title: Hike with us
notes.content: Take a journey through a magical world of caves, meet a wildefloof,  quatropus and an armapillipogue, discover hidden knickknacks. The developers who will play are the creators of the story, animation and art for the Cave Hikers.
